profile.description:
Horse Girl, Gear Tester, & Adult Ammy

Welcome to my channel!

I test equestrian products, review riding gear, vlog horse shows, try internet-famous horse products, and document the ups and downs of learning to ride as an adult.

Here you don't have to be a pro to love this sport. You just need to love the journey.

videos.description: I’m so disappointed in these, especially for $400. Is there something I’m missing?   #equestrian #stirrups #ridinggear #equestrianproblems
I could NOT get a distance right today… either too long or chipping in every time. What do you think is harder, seeing the distance or fixing it once you see it? #equestrian #horseriding #horsegirl

Coming from the hunter ring, this felt like a completely different sport. Faster, less controlled, and no room for error. Would you try cross country or stick to the ring? 👀 #equestrian #crosscountryjumping #ireland #pov #eventing
I was so impressed and intrigued I had to try this… I’m truly not worthy yet though 😂😅 #equestrian #horseriding #workoutfail

Can a gadget actually help fix your riding position? 👀 I tested the Position Reminder from Correct Connect to see if it could help with one of my most stubborn riding habits. Would you try it? #equestrian #horseriding #hunterjumper #ridingposition
At first I thought this was weird, but I actually kind of like it! Would you try aromatherapy for your horse? #equestrian #horses #equestriangear #hanoverian

I field tested the ~$300 Veredus Gel Vento against the ~$100 Shires Arma Oxizone for 10 rides 👀 And after all that testing? The results were way closer than I expected, especially considering the price difference. Informal real-world test on one horse. 🐴 #equestrian #horses #equestriangear #hunterjumper #adultammy

I found an equestrian jumpsuit on the internet… so, I wore it to the barn. I had to know: is there actually something to it, or is it completely horrible? 😂 #Equestrian #HorseRiding #ridingoutfit #equestrianjumpsuit

$225 vs $60 safety stirrups 👀 They look almost identical, but are they actually comparable? I tested the Acavallo Ala Pro against a Temu dupe to see how close they really are. Would you save or splurge? #Equestrian #HorseTok #EquestrianTikTok #SafetyStirrups #HorseRiding
I was so intrigued by this helmet and its interchangeable parts, I had to buy it and try it out. What do you think? #equestrian #hunterjumper #ridinghelmet #lemieux
I’ve accumulated way too many show breeches… so it’s time to rank them 😅 #equestrian #hunterjumper #equestrianstyle
I had to find out if this show jacket was actually decent or total trash, what I got surprised me! #equestrian #hunterjumper #horses #saveorsplurge
